collecte.texte: Your precise GPS position, recorded for the whole duration of the guidance.

arrierePlan.texte: Recording continues when the screen is off or the app is no longer in the foreground, so guidance can continue with the phone in your pocket.

usage.texte: Only to guide you: to place your position on the route and announce the next instruction. It is neither kept, nor used for advertising, nor passed on to third parties for that purpose.

localisation.retrait: You can withdraw this permission at any time in your phone settings. Details in our <lien>privacy policy</lien>.

carte.texte: The blue dot follows your position: you can tell at a glance where you are and which way you are heading.

itineraire.texte: “My location” becomes a possible starting point, with no address to type.

usage.texte: Your location is used to show you on the map and to compute your route. It is not stored, not used for advertising and not shared with third parties.

position.bloqueeTexte: Allow location for Sécu'Cycle in your phone settings.

notifications.titre: Follow the guidance without looking at your screen

instruction.texte: It shows in the notification bar, phone in your pocket or screen off.

discret.texte: No sound, no vibration: the notification stays silent for the whole ride.

retrait.texte: You can turn it off from the app settings.
